title: Kicksled Race
tagline: Kick, glide and race the snow.
description: A Nordic winter racer seen from the side: stand on the runners of a chair-fronted kicksled, kick on the ring, glide to recover and read the course. Four courses, three rivals, ghosts and a daily run.
howToPlay: Tap KICK, or anywhere on the scene, when the ring is full.
Tap GLIDE to crouch: less drag, faster recovery, safer bends.
Stand up before bumps: tap GLIDE again or kick.
Kick on climbs and soft snow, glide on slopes and ice.
Beat three rivals, or the ghost of your best run.
